access.instructions: Follow the official SketchGraphs 'Filtered sequence' train, validation and test links. Save each original file under dataset/local/raw/sketchgraphs_filtered. Record file sizes, checksums and publication source. Do not accidentally acquire the separate 43GB raw or 15GB full-sequence release.
